n7cd39660b4.headline: Management crisis at Megurit: CEO also reviews his path, entrepreneur Rozenbuch becomes temporary chairman
n7cd39660b4.summary: Following resignations of chairman and director, CEO Mati Dov awaits decisions on replacements; fund founder Erez Rozenbuch becomes temporary chairman.
n7cd39660b4.why: Megurit is an Israeli company facing leadership instability, which can affect its strategic direction and investor confidence.

ne079cd678f.headline: Exporters celebrate a national measure on foreign exchange
ne079cd678f.summary: Argentina repealed the requirement for exporters to settle export dollars within the country, a measure welcomed by exporters.
ne079cd678f.why: Foreign exchange controls affect trade flows and currency stability; easing such rules can impact export competitiveness and FX markets.
